Text.Text: The preserve is clear of that school. Help your beast endure because it trusts you, never because it fears you. You've finished my Unbreakable Beast trials. I have no further work for you here.
These trials require rank 50 in Beast Mastery. Reach that rank as a handler, then come back. Toughness starts with knowing what your beast can bear.

A keeper crew took over my preserve and calls beatings training. Recover their tally so I can account for what they've done. Defeat six Unbreakable Beast Adepts in Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Their defeat secures the Unbreakable Beast Tarn Hunt Tally; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Czerka Base. I'll give you the Dathomir Tarn Jungle Preserve Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Unbreakable Beast.

Here's the Dathomir Tarn Jungle Preserve Key. Use 'Tarn Jungle Preserve' in Dathomir, Tarnished Jungles. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Unbreakable Beast Adepts, then return with the Unbreakable Beast Tarn Hunt Tally.

Beat a beast enough, it stops flinching. Looks like toughness. It's just damage with nowhere left to feel. Real endurance holds because it chose to hold, not because it's too broken to notice pain anymore. Different thing entirely.
Only honest test there is. Not how hard you hit. How much you take and still stand up after. Anyone can swing once. Standing through the swing that should've dropped you, that's the whole discipline.
Every hit those adepts land gets scratched onto that tally. Proof, plain as anything, of exactly how they've been running my preserve. Bring it back whole and it stops being their scoreboard.
Defeat six Unbreakable Beast Adepts in Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Their defeat secures the Unbreakable Beast Tarn Hunt Tally; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Czerka Base.
You've defeated six Unbreakable Beast Adepts. Let me see the Unbreakable Beast Tarn Hunt Tally.
That's the record I needed. We can account for the trails again. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists have moved from beatings to chemical pressure. Take back their scent vial. Defeat five Unbreakable Beast Specialists in Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Their defeat secures the Unbreakable Beast Beast-Pen Scent Vial; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Czerka Base.
Your key still grants access to Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Defeat five Unbreakable Beast Specialists to secure the Unbreakable Beast Beast-Pen Scent Vial, then return to me.

Dosed to keep pain constant, low enough the beast can't rest, high enough it never toughens right. Bring that vial back whole and I've got proof of exactly what they've been dosing my animals with. Proof holds up better than my word alone.

Beatings leave marks people ask questions about. A needle's quieter. Same cruelty, harder to prove, which is exactly why they switched. Doesn't make it toughening. Makes it worse, honestly, because at least a beating ends.

No. Pain that never lets up isn't a test, it's just damage on a drip. My beasts endure because they trust the hand holding the line, not because the line never stops hurting. That trust is the whole difference between unbreakable and just broken slowly.
Defeat five Unbreakable Beast Specialists in Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Their defeat secures the Unbreakable Beast Beast-Pen Scent Vial; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Czerka Base.
You've defeated five Unbreakable Beast Specialists. Let me see the Unbreakable Beast Beast-Pen Scent Vial.
This belongs with the handlers who know how to use it. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden protects those methods. Recover his alpha totem and break that authority. Defeat the Unbreakable Beast Warden in Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Their defeat secures the Unbreakable Beast Clawed Alpha Totem; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Czerka Base. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Unbreakable Beast Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Unbreakable Beast Clawed Alpha Totem.

Took hits on purpose, for years, past any sense of it. Somewhere in there he stopped choosing to endure and started just being unable to feel it anymore. That's the difference between him and me, and it's the whole reason he's dangerous now.

Alpha totem marks the toughest bloodline in the pens, the one every other animal learns to hold from. He's got it clawed to pieces because he clawed the real bloodline apart himself, replaced it with whatever survives beating instead of whatever endures honestly. Bring it back whole and the real line's proven again.

I recommend two companions against the Unbreakable Beast Warden. Spread the pressure so one person doesn't have to carry the whole fight. You can enter alone, but prepare carefully before you call the challenge.

Defeat the Unbreakable Beast Warden in Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Their defeat secures the Unbreakable Beast Clawed Alpha Totem; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Czerka Base. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Unbreakable Beast Warden. Let me see the Unbreakable Beast Clawed Alpha Totem.
The totem is back in our keeping. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

Four keepers still control the preserve's training. Take their token out of the pens. Defeat four members of the Unbreakable Beast Inner Circle in Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Their defeat secures the Unbreakable Beast Preserve Keeper's Token; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Czerka Base.
Your key still grants access to Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Defeat four members of the Unbreakable Beast Inner Circle to secure the Unbreakable Beast Preserve Keeper's Token, then return to me.

Taught him to stop feeling it. That's their whole doctrine down there: pain isn't something you endure, it's something you stop noticing. Difference between that and real endurance is everything. One's a choice you keep making. The other's just numbness with good posture.

That token's proof of who's allowed to run the deep floor, sign off on the pens, all of it. They minted fakes to cover for each other. One real token, and every fake signature they've made gets thrown out with it.

Beast holds for the master. Master holds for the beast. Neither one's numb to the other, and neither one stops choosing it, hit after hit. That's the whole bond, shared both directions. Not one thing enduring alone. Two things enduring together.

Defeat four members of the Unbreakable Beast Inner Circle in Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Their defeat secures the Unbreakable Beast Preserve Keeper's Token; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Czerka Base.
You've defeated four members of the Unbreakable Beast Inner Circle. Let me see the Unbreakable Beast Preserve Keeper's Token.
The keepers can no longer claim authority here. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

Their master is the last keeper enforcing those methods. Defeat him in the Alpha Beast Hollow and end the abuse. Defeat the Unbreakable Beast Master in Dathomir, Alpha Beast Hollow. Report back to me here in Dathomir, Czerka Base; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Dathomir, Alpha Beast Hollow, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Unbreakable Beast Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

Warden stopped feeling it. He stopped needing to feel it in the first place. That's further along the same road, and it's exactly what I've spent my whole life teaching, done right, for the wrong reasons. You've been building the true version this whole trial. He's the corrupted end of the same road.

Because one hit, however hard, is still one hit, and his hide's outlasted worse alone. A dozen hits, all at once, from every side, and there's no single point for that endurance to brace against anymore. That's the whole math of taking down something built not to break.

It means what it always meant. Beast holds for master, master holds for beast, both of you choosing it every single hit, never numb to each other even when you're numb to everything else. That's what he lost somewhere in all this. Don't lose it yourself.

Defeat the Unbreakable Beast Master in Dathomir, Alpha Beast Hollow. Report back to me here in Dathomir, Czerka Base; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Unbreakable Beast Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The preserve is clear of that school. Help your beast endure because it trusts you, never because it fears you. You've earned the right to train Unbreakable Beast. Your final payment is ready.
Back to standing.
I'll defeat six Unbreakable Beast Adepts.
What do you mean, toughen with beatings?
What does endurance actually test?
What's this tally worth?
Not yet.
Here's the Unbreakable Beast Tarn Hunt Tally.
Back to standing.
I'll defeat five Unbreakable Beast Specialists.
What's in that vial exactly?
Why move from beatings to needles?
Can a beast under that pain still endure honestly?
Give me a day.
Here's the Unbreakable Beast Beast-Pen Scent Vial.
Back to standing.
I'll defeat the Unbreakable Beast Warden.
How'd his hide get like that?
What does the alpha totem prove?
Why do blades bounce off him specifically?
Haven't got the right friends yet.
Here's the Unbreakable Beast Clawed Alpha Totem.
Back to standing.
I'll defeat four members of the Unbreakable Beast Inner Circle.
What did they teach the warden, exactly?
What's this keeper's token prove?
What does an unbreakable bond actually share?
My people need to rest first.
Here's the Unbreakable Beast Preserve Keeper's Token.
Back to standing.
I'll face the Unbreakable Beast Master and report back.
How's his endurance different from the warden's?
Why does it take all of us to break one hide?
What does an unbreakable bond mean, once he's gone?
Not till everyone's ready.
The Unbreakable Beast Master is defeated. Here's my report.
